from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List

class DocumentClassification(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document with its assigned legal cause."""
    title: str = Field(description="The specific title of the judgment document (e.g., 《判决文书1》)")
    cause_category: Literal['危害公共安全罪', '行政行为 - 行政受理', '侵犯公民人身权利，民主权利罪', '知识产权与竞争', '渎职罪', '执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议'] = Field(description="The cause category assigned to this document from the fixed task list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed document classifications."""
    documents: List[DocumentClassification] = Field(description="List of all documents found and classified")
